label: WRONG
reason: Most utils functions (color_from_value, text.py helpers, username.py lookups) return no HTTP response at all, so not redirecting is a side effect of what they do. The one outlier, utils/url.py#redirect_inline, is a redirect decorator whose whole job is to redirect to reverse(redirect_url_name), which is safe, and similar redirect decorators come up again (utils/session_checks.py#login_redirect, utils/username.py#redirect_if_old_username, which also redirects to a reverse()d URL). 0 of 1 counted outliers is a mistake, and ruff has no rule for this.
